measurement: ./gw koverReport -Pkover.jvmTest=true --console=plain (from clean per-module kover dirs; the settings-level aggregate writes build/reports/kover/report.xml)

floors.label: feature/agenda, excluding Compose-only subtrees
floors.note: The excluded subtrees are Compose-only. They used to be excluded because the per-module report could not see the desktopApp flow tests that cover them, which made the whole scope read 33.18% and said more about the harness than about the tests. The settings-level aggregate now includes those tests, so the exclusion is a choice about what this floor measures, not a workaround — whole scope now reads 76.02%. If the desktopApp task stops running, the excluded subtrees go back to uncovered and this floor will not notice; that is the one reason to keep the exclusion narrow.

floors.label: whole codebase (com/singularity/todo/, every module)
floors.note: The floor that makes the per-feature floors mean something: without it, deleting every test in feature/tasks would leave the gate green. The scope is a package prefix, and the aggregate report covers every module, so this is the whole codebase — desktopApp and androidApp included — not just :shared. Named for what it measures; the old label said 'whole shared module' while measuring the app.

floors.label: feature/tasks (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Largest feature by line count. Without its own floor, deleting every task test would still leave the whole-module floor green.

floors.label: feature/notes (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Second largest. Same reasoning as tasks.

floors.label: feature/projects (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Cascade deletes and parent/child relationships live here; a regression there is expensive to find by hand.

floors.label: feature/ai (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Every AI call is metered into llm_usage, so an unnoticed coverage drop here also hides an untested billing path.

floors.label: feature/search (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Best-covered feature; the floor exists to keep it that way as code is added.

floors.label: feature/proposals (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Previously a Livewire screen port; coverage there is the regression guard for the port.

floors.label: feature/calendar_sync (per-feature floor)
floors.note: Long-lived debounced collector, hard to test by hand.
